_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Arthur Machen (1863-1947) as translator: the Memoirs of Casanova (privately printed, 1894), shelved once as Gutenberg's complete text. Machen's own fiction is not a translation and is not here. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 21); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
